description: This file implements the JSON-RPC interface for the PersistentStore component, including registration of RPC endpoints, handling of store operations such as set, get, delete, and namespace management, and interaction with underlying store and cache components.

classes.name: PersistentStore
classes.description: Class implementing JSON-RPC endpoints for persistent storage operations, managing registration, and interaction with underlying store components.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all RPC endpoints for persistent store operations.

methods.name: endpoint_setValue
methods.description: Sets a value in the persistent store.

methods.name: endpoint_getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the persistent store.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key from the persistent store.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes a namespace from the persistent store.

methods.name: endpoint_getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSize
methods.description: Deprecated. Retrieves storage size per namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSizes
methods.description: Retrieves storage sizes for all namespaces.

methods.name: endpoint_getNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_setNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.
